tweets.text: Within my first year in office, I made it a priority to visit each of the 20 U.S. Border Patrol sectors, as well as the Academy and SOG Headquarters. With recent visits to the Buffalo and Houlton Sectors, I completed this goal, which gave me the opportunity to meet directly with agents to discuss operational impacts, address challenges, and celebrate achievements. By engaging with frontline teams and reaffirming their vital role in protecting our homeland, I continue to strengthen our collective commitment to national security.

tweets.text:
PROSECUTION UPDATE! 
 
An illegal alien who recklessly abandoned his passengers during a failed human smuggling attempt, costing two lives, has been sentenced to 8 years in prison. Last March, he drove into a canal and left his victims behind to drown.
 
Human smuggling destroys lives and carries real consequences. Our commitment is clear: If you break the law, you will be prosecuted to the fullest extent.

Yesterday, I met Commander Bovino in Minneapolis to meet with our agents and DHS law enforcement partners. We remain unified in our mission to protect our country, support our agents, and enforce the law. We will not be intimidated out of this city, or any other city. We swore an oath to uphold the rule of law, and we will not stop until we remove every criminal illegal alien from our communities. 

@DHSgov @CBP @CMDROpAtLargeCA

tweets.text:
BREAKING: Convicted Murderer Living Under Alias Busted in Houston
 
A convicted murderer, illegally in the U.S., was discovered hiding in plain sight in Houston, TX. Despite a 45-year sentence, he was released and wrongly identified as a U.S. citizen after serving time. In reality, he is a national of the Commonwealth of Dominica. He is now back in custody and facing deportation. 

Justice served, and our communities are safer.
